Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Baidu Com (BIDU) Holder Paradigm Asset Management Co Has Boosted Its Stake by $247.69 Million as Market Valuation Rose; Private Harbour Investment Management & Counsel Has Boosted Its Knowles (KN) Stake by $333,180; Valuation Declined 
March 2, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc increased its stake in Baidu Com Inc (BIDU) by 200% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc bought 1,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 1,500 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $371.54M, up from 500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc who had been investing in Baidu Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $86.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $1.17 during the last trading session, reaching $248.58. About 1.48 million shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has risen 12.02% since March 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.68% the S&P500. 
Private Harbour Investment Management & Counsel Llc increased its stake in Knowles Corp (KN) by 22.78% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Harbour Investment Management & Counsel Llc bought 22,212 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.91% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 119,701 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.83 million, up from 97,489 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Private Harbour Investment Management & Counsel Llc who had been investing in Knowles Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.30 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.87% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $14.52. About 389,836 shares traded. Knowles Corporation (NYSE:KN) has risen 40.62% since March 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.92% the S&P500. 
Among 13 analysts covering Knowles Corporation ( NYSE:KN ), 6 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 46% are positive. Knowles Corporation had 24 analyst reports since August 20, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Benchmark initiated it with “Hold” rating and $15 target in Wednesday, June 29 report. Susquehanna initiated the stock with “Negative” rating in Tuesday, September 20 report. FBR Capital downgraded Knowles Corporation (NYSE:KN) on Tuesday, October 27 to “Underperform” rating. FBR Capital maintained the stock with “Underperform” rating in Friday, February 12 report. The rating was maintained by Lake Street with “Buy” on Tuesday, January 12. The stock has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Tuesday, September 6. The stock of Knowles Corporation (NYSE:KN) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, February 8 by Susquehanna. On Wednesday, December 20 the stock rating was initiated by Piper Jaffray with “Hold”. The company was maintained on Friday, February 12 by Topeka Capital Markets. The firm earned “Sell” rating on Thursday, September 17 by Zacks. 
Among 24 analysts covering Baidu ( NASDAQ:BIDU ), 9 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Baidu had 61 analyst reports since July 28, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, February 15. As per Tuesday, January 23, the company rating was downgraded by Jefferies. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, September 28 by Deutsche Bank. Stifel Nicolaus upgraded it to “Buy” rating and $220 target in Tuesday, January 10 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Monday, September 18. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Monday, June 13 by Citigroup. The stock has “Hold” rating by TH Capital on Friday, July 29. The stock of Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, May 11 by Morgan Stanley. Credit Suisse maintained the shares of BIDU in report on Monday, February 22 with “Outperform” rating. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, October 20 by Jefferies. 
Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc, which manages about $386.05B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Praxair Inc. (NYSE:PX) by 7,650 shares to 21,710 shares, valued at $3.03B in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Hartford Fincl. Srv (NYSE:HIG) by 7,400 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 21,300 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL).   Dolores Ford
